title: Tell verifier to put cited Athena checks in the commands list
summary: Edit the verifier prompt so each recorded fmt/clippy/test check it cites goes in that criterion's commands list, exactly as shown under "Checks Athena ran on this tree", not only in evidence text. Add a CHANGELOG entry. Audience: the change verifier and the maintainer reading rejections.

defaults_applied.how: One sentence added to one prompt plus a changelog entry.
Budget and crate tests are behavior criteria.
Criterion checks the instruction names the commands list, which is what D43 reads.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The existing sentence is edited in place with a short addition; no other prompt text changes.
The prompt's wording on 'a failed or missing record' stays as is.

acceptance_criteria.text: verifier.md says that each recorded check cited goes in that criterion's commands list, exactly as shown under 'Checks Athena ran on this tree', and that quoting it only in evidence text is not enough (D43 reads only the commands list).
CHANGELOG.md has an entry under Unreleased naming the cause (job 20261024-033935-c4w4, empty commands list, D43) and the prompt change.
Only crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md and CHANGELOG.md differ from the base (git diff --stat).
The budgets test passes and shows the change verifier inside its token budget: run cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets -- --nocapture.
Existing tests that read the verifier prompt still pass: run cargo test -p athena-cap-change.

departures: Small prompt-only edit with a budget test; cheaper and likelier to pass than the reference, but budget headroom is unknown.
